import { createHash } from "node:crypto";

import { createKernelEvent } from "./research-control-plane-kernel.mjs";
import {
  appendResearchControlPlaneEvent,
  appendResearchControlPlaneEvents,
  DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT,
  loadResearchControlPlaneStore,
} from "./research-control-plane-store.mjs";
import {
  changeAutonomyMode,
  issueBoundedAutonomyGrant,
  isWorkItemWithinBoundedGrant,
  revokeAgentLease,
  revokeBoundedAutonomyGrant,
} from "./research-control-plane-runtime.mjs";
import { classifyResearchField, classifyResearchWorkItem, orderResearchWorkItemsFieldFair, RESEARCH_FIELDS, RESEARCH_SCHEDULING_TIERS } from "./research-scheduling-policy.mjs";
import { compileResearchActivityPacket, compileResearchContinuationPacket, compileResearchDecompositionPacket, freezeCompiledTaskPacket } from "./research-task-packet-compiler.mjs";

export const RESEARCH_MISSION_CONTROL_PROTOCOL = "claimipedia-research-mission-control/1.0";
export const RESEARCH_MISSION_CONTROL_ROUTE = "/research-control-plane/mission";
export const RESEARCH_MISSION_CONTROL_API = "/api/research-control-plane/mission";
export const MISSION_MODES = Object.freeze(["SHADOW", "SUPERVISED", "BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS"]);
export const NOTIFICATION_SEVERITIES = Object.freeze(["info", "result", "attention", "significant", "error", "critical"]);
export const BUILTIN_PRIORITY_LENSES = Object.freeze([
  { id: "field-fair", name: "Field-fair scheduler", description: "Round-robin across research fields, then use each field's internal tier and priority order." },
  { id: "global-promise", name: "Global promise · comparative", description: "A cross-field heuristic combining committed priority, information gain, tractability and programme centrality; not a probability." },
  { id: "committed", name: "Committed priority", description: "The human-ratified ordering recorded in the ledger." },
  { id: "cheap-falsification", name: "Cheap falsification", description: "Prefer tractable, discriminating tests over broad high-burden bridges." },
  { id: "information-gain", name: "Information gain", description: "Prefer tasks likely to split the hypothesis space." },
  { id: "mainline-centrality", name: "Mainline centrality", description: "Prefer tasks nearest the Spin(2,3) programme core." },
  { id: "starvation-rescue", name: "Starvation rescue", description: "Expose old or repeatedly bypassed work without committing it." },
]);

const freeze = value => Object.freeze(structuredClone(value));
const digest = value => createHash("sha256").update(JSON.stringify(value)).digest("hex");
const slug = value => String(value || "research").normalize("NFKD").replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/^-|-$/g, "").toLowerCase().slice(0, 32) || "research";
const compactTime = occurredAt => String(occurredAt).replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 12);
const nextId = (prefix, values) => `${prefix}-${String(values.length + 1).padStart(4, "0")}`;
const missionWorkers = ({ sessionId, count, allowedStreamIds, startingOrdinal = 0 }) => Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => {
  const ordinal = startingOrdinal + index + 1;
  return { id: `${sessionId}-W${String(ordinal).padStart(2, "0")}`, ordinal, role: ordinal === startingOrdinal + count && count > 1 ? "synthesis" : "inquiry", lane: allowedStreamIds[(ordinal - 1) % allowedStreamIds.length] };
});

async function append({ root, type, aggregateType, aggregateId, payload, actor, occurredAt }) {
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 24; attempt += 1) {
    const loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
    const event = createKernelEvent({
      sequence: loaded.checkpoint.sequence + 1,
      eventId: `RCPK-${String(loaded.checkpoint.sequence + 1).padStart(4, "0")}`,
      type,
      aggregate: { type: aggregateType, id: aggregateId },
      payload,
      actor,
      occurredAt,
    });
    try {
      await appendResearchControlPlaneEvent({ root, event });
      return event;
    } catch (error) {
      // Retrying a semantic event after an event-id conflict is unsafe: another
      // writer may already have performed the same state transition. Let the
      // caller reload and revalidate aggregate state before trying again.
      const retryableWriterRace = error.message === "kernel-store-writer-busy";
      if (!retryableWriterRace || attempt === 23) throw error;
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, Math.min(250, 25 * (attempt + 1))));
    }
  }
  throw new Error("research-mission-event-append-retry-exhausted");
}

export function generateResearchSessionIdentity({ label = "", occurredAt = new Date().toISOString(), ordinal = 1 } = {}) {
  const stamp = compactTime(occurredAt);
  const suffix = slug(label);
  return freeze({ id: `SESSION-${stamp}-${String(ordinal).padStart(2, "0")}`, name: `${stamp}-${suffix}` });
}

export async function startResearchMissionSession({
  root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT,
  parallelWorkers = 3,
  label = "",
  meta = "",
  mode = "SHADOW",
  allowedStreamIds = ["STR-SPN", "STR-MTH", "STR-LIT"],
  maximumWallClockMinutes = 60,
  maximumFailures = 1,
  maximumTotalLeases = 1000,
  leaseRenewalThreshold = 10,
  leaseRenewalIncrement = maximumTotalLeases,
  progressiveTimeoutThreshold = 2,
  extendedLeaseDurationMinutes = 60,
  autoRenew = true,
  humanId = "human.browser-operator",
  occurredAt = new Date().toISOString(),
} = {}) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(parallelWorkers) || parallelWorkers < 1 || parallelWorkers > 8) throw new Error("mission-parallel-workers-out-of-range");
  if (!MISSION_MODES.includes(mode)) throw new Error("mission-mode-invalid");
  if (!Array.isArray(allowedStreamIds) || !allowedStreamIds.length) throw new Error("mission-stream-scope-required");
  if (!Number.isInteger(maximumWallClockMinutes) || maximumWallClockMinutes < 1 || maximumWallClockMinutes > 1440) throw new Error("mission-duration-out-of-range");
  if (!Number.isInteger(maximumFailures) || maximumFailures < 0 || maximumFailures > 20) throw new Error("mission-failure-budget-out-of-range");
  const loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  const active = Object.values(loaded.state.researchSessions).find(session => ["active", "paused", "stopping"].includes(session.status));
  if (active) throw new Error(`mission-session-already-active:${active.id}`);
  const identity = generateResearchSessionIdentity({ label, occurredAt, ordinal: Object.keys(loaded.state.researchSessions).length + 1 });
  const rationale = `Mission Control start: ${identity.name}`;
  const bounds = { maximumLeases: parallelWorkers, maximumTotalLeases, leaseRenewalThreshold, leaseRenewalIncrement, maximumWallClockMinutes, maximumFailures, progressiveTimeoutThreshold, extendedLeaseDurationMinutes, allowedStreamIds };
  await changeAutonomyMode({ root, to: mode, humanId, rationale, confirmation: `AUTHORIZE ${mode}`, bounds: mode === "BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS" ? bounds : null, occurredAt });
  let grantId = null;
  if (mode === "BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS") {
    const grant = await issueBoundedAutonomyGrant({ root, humanId, rationale, confirmation: "GRANT BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS", allowedStreamIds, maximumLeases: parallelWorkers, maximumTotalLeases, leaseRenewalThreshold, leaseRenewalIncrement, maximumWallClockMinutes, maximumFailures, progressiveTimeoutThreshold, extendedLeaseDurationMinutes, selfRenewal: autoRenew, occurredAt });
    grantId = grant.grantId;
  }
  const workers = missionWorkers({ sessionId: identity.id, count: parallelWorkers, allowedStreamIds });
  const payload = {
    protocol: RESEARCH_MISSION_CONTROL_PROTOCOL,
    name: identity.name,
    label: String(label || "").trim(),
    meta: String(meta || "").trim(),
    mode,
    grantId,
    allowedStreamIds,
    bounds,
    autoRenew: mode === "BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS" && autoRenew === true,
    workers,
    reviewer: { id: `${identity.id}-R01`, role: "independent-review" },
    scheduling: mode === "BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS" ? "bounded-scheduler-authorized" : mode === "SUPERVISED" ? "human-release-required" : "recommend-only",
    externalEffectsAuthorized: false,
  };
  await append({ root, type: "ResearchSessionStarted", aggregateType: "research-session", aggregateId: identity.id, payload, actor: { type: "human", id: humanId }, occurredAt });
  await raiseResearchNotification({ root, sessionId: identity.id, category: "platform", severity: "info", title: `${identity.name} started`, simpleExplanation: `${parallelWorkers} worker lanes are ready in ${mode} mode.`, whyItMatters: mode === "BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS" ? "The scheduler may issue only locally bounded, pre-approved work; external effects remain forbidden." : "No research execution can occur without the next governed release step.", technicalJustification: `Session ${identity.id} is backed by a durable start event${grantId ? ` and finite grant ${grantId}` : ""}.`, links: [{ label: "Mission Control", href: RESEARCH_MISSION_CONTROL_ROUTE }], occurredAt, actor: { type: "system", id: "mission-control-v1" } });
  return { sessionId: identity.id, session: (await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root })).state.researchSessions[identity.id], store: await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root }) };
}

export async function addResearchMissionWorkers({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, sessionId, count = 1, humanId = "human.browser-operator", occurredAt = new Date().toISOString() } = {}) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 8) throw new Error("mission-worker-add-count-invalid");
  const loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  const session = loaded.state.researchSessions[sessionId];
  if (!session || !["active", "paused"].includes(session.status)) throw new Error("mission-session-not-bound");
  const startingOrdinal = Math.max(0, ...Object.values(session.workers).map(worker => worker.ordinal || 0));
  const workers = missionWorkers({ sessionId, count, allowedStreamIds: session.allowedStreamIds, startingOrdinal });
  await append({ root, type: "ResearchSessionWorkersAdded", aggregateType: "research-session-workers", aggregateId: `WORKERS-${sessionId}-${String(startingOrdinal + 1).padStart(2, "0")}`, payload: { sessionId, workers }, actor: { type: "human", id: humanId }, occurredAt });
  const store = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  return { sessionId, workers, session: store.state.researchSessions[sessionId], store };
}

export async function authorizeResearchMissionSession({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, sessionId, targetWorkers = 4, maximumWallClockMinutes = 60, maximumFailures = 1, maximumTotalLeases = 1000, leaseRenewalThreshold = 10, leaseRenewalIncrement = maximumTotalLeases, progressiveTimeoutThreshold = 2, extendedLeaseDurationMinutes = 60, autoRenew = true, humanId = "human.browser-operator", occurredAt = new Date().toISOString() } = {}) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(targetWorkers) || targetWorkers < 1 || targetWorkers > 8) throw new Error("mission-target-worker-count-invalid");
  const loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  const session = loaded.state.researchSessions[sessionId];
  if (!session || !["active", "paused"].includes(session.status)) throw new Error("mission-session-not-active");
  const liveWorkers = Object.values(session.workers).filter(worker => !["stopped", "failed", "complete"].includes(worker.status));
  const addCount = Math.max(0, targetWorkers - liveWorkers.length);
  const startingOrdinal = Math.max(0, ...Object.values(session.workers).map(worker => worker.ordinal || 0));
  const workers = missionWorkers({ sessionId, count: addCount, allowedStreamIds: session.allowedStreamIds, startingOrdinal });
  const bounds = { maximumLeases: targetWorkers, maximumTotalLeases, leaseRenewalThreshold, leaseRenewalIncrement, maximumWallClockMinutes, maximumFailures, progressiveTimeoutThreshold, extendedLeaseDurationMinutes, allowedStreamIds: session.allowedStreamIds };
  await changeAutonomyMode({ root, to: "BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS", humanId, rationale: `Explicitly run bound mission ${sessionId}`, confirmation: "AUTHORIZE BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS", bounds, occurredAt });
  const grant = await issueBoundedAutonomyGrant({ root, humanId, rationale: `Explicitly run bound mission ${sessionId}`, confirmation: "GRANT BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS", allowedStreamIds: session.allowedStreamIds, maximumLeases: targetWorkers, maximumTotalLeases, leaseRenewalThreshold, leaseRenewalIncrement, maximumWallClockMinutes, maximumFailures, progressiveTimeoutThreshold, extendedLeaseDurationMinutes, selfRenewal: autoRenew, occurredAt });
  await append({ root, type: "ResearchSessionReauthorized", aggregateType: "research-session", aggregateId: sessionId, payload: { mode: "BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS", grantId: grant.grantId, bounds, autoRenew: autoRenew === true, scheduling: "bounded-scheduler-authorized", workers }, actor: { type: "human", id: humanId }, occurredAt });
  const store = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  return { sessionId, workers, session: store.state.researchSessions[sessionId], store };
}

export async function bindResearchMissionSession({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, sessionId = null, parallelWorkers = 1, mode = "BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS", maximumWallClockMinutes = 60, maximumFailures = 1, maximumTotalLeases = 1000, leaseRenewalThreshold = 10, leaseRenewalIncrement = maximumTotalLeases, progressiveTimeoutThreshold = 2, extendedLeaseDurationMinutes = 60, autoRenew = true, humanId = "human.browser-operator", occurredAt = new Date().toISOString() } = {}) {
  await reconcileResearchUnblockTasks({ root, occurredAt });
  let loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  const sessions = Object.values(loaded.state.researchSessions).sort((a, b) => b.startedAt.localeCompare(a.startedAt));
  const session = sessionId ? loaded.state.researchSessions[sessionId] : sessions[0];
  if (!session) return startResearchMissionSession({ root, parallelWorkers, mode, maximumWallClockMinutes, maximumFailures, maximumTotalLeases, leaseRenewalThreshold, leaseRenewalIncrement, progressiveTimeoutThreshold, extendedLeaseDurationMinutes, autoRenew, humanId, occurredAt });
  if (["active", "paused"].includes(session.status)) return addResearchMissionWorkers({ root, sessionId: session.id, count: parallelWorkers, humanId, occurredAt });
  if (!["idle", "stopped"].includes(session.status)) throw new Error("mission-session-not-bindable");
  const allowedStreamIds = session.allowedStreamIds?.length ? session.allowedStreamIds : ["STR-SPN", "STR-MTH", "STR-LIT"];
  const bounds = { maximumLeases: parallelWorkers, maximumTotalLeases, leaseRenewalThreshold, leaseRenewalIncrement, maximumWallClockMinutes, maximumFailures, progressiveTimeoutThreshold, extendedLeaseDurationMinutes, allowedStreamIds };
  if (loaded.state.autonomy.mode !== mode) await changeAutonomyMode({ root, to: mode, humanId, rationale: `Bind existing mission ${session.id}`, confirmation: `AUTHORIZE ${mode}`, bounds: mode === "BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS" ? bounds : null, occurredAt });
  let grantId = null;
  if (mode === "BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS") {
    const grant = await issueBoundedAutonomyGrant({ root, humanId, rationale: `Bind existing mission ${session.id}`, confirmation: "GRANT BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS", allowedStreamIds, maximumLeases: parallelWorkers, maximumTotalLeases, leaseRenewalThreshold, leaseRenewalIncrement, maximumWallClockMinutes, maximumFailures, progressiveTimeoutThreshold, extendedLeaseDurationMinutes, selfRenewal: autoRenew, occurredAt });
    grantId = grant.grantId;
  }
  loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  const startingOrdinal = Math.max(0, ...Object.values(session.workers).map(worker => worker.ordinal || 0));
  const workers = missionWorkers({ sessionId: session.id, count: parallelWorkers, allowedStreamIds, startingOrdinal });
  await append({ root, type: "ResearchSessionBound", aggregateType: "research-session", aggregateId: session.id, payload: { mode, grantId, allowedStreamIds, bounds, autoRenew: mode === "BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS" && autoRenew === true, workers, scheduling: mode === "BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS" ? "bounded-scheduler-authorized" : mode === "SUPERVISED" ? "human-release-required" : "recommend-only" }, actor: { type: "human", id: humanId }, occurredAt });
  const store = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  return { sessionId: session.id, workers, session: store.state.researchSessions[session.id], store };
}

export async function quiesceResearchMissionSession({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, sessionId, humanId = "human.browser-operator", reason = "All runners stopped", actorType = "human", workerStatus = "stopped", occurredAt = new Date().toISOString() } = {}) {
  let loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  const session = loaded.state.researchSessions[sessionId];
  if (!session || session.status === "idle") return { appended: false, session, store: loaded };
  if (!["active", "paused", "stopping"].includes(session.status)) throw new Error("mission-session-not-quiesceable");
  const openLeases = Object.entries(loaded.state.leases).filter(([, lease]) => Object.keys(session.workers).includes(lease.agentId) && ["issued", "active"].includes(lease.status));
  for (const [leaseId] of openLeases) await revokeAgentLease({ root, leaseId, humanId, reason, returnTo: "eligible", occurredAt, actorType });
  loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  for (const worker of Object.values(loaded.state.researchSessions[sessionId].workers).filter(item => !["stopped", "complete", "failed"].includes(item.status))) await updateMissionWorker({ root, sessionId, workerId: worker.id, status: workerStatus, currentTask: null, detail: reason, occurredAt, actor: { type: actorType, id: humanId } });
  loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  const grantId = loaded.state.researchSessions[sessionId].grantId;
  if (grantId && loaded.state.autonomy.grants[grantId]?.status === "active") await revokeBoundedAutonomyGrant({ root, grantId, humanId, reason: `Mission ${sessionId} quiesced: ${reason}`, actorType, occurredAt });
  loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  if (loaded.state.autonomy.mode !== "OFF") await changeAutonomyMode({ root, to: "OFF", humanId, rationale: `Mission ${sessionId} quiesced: ${reason}`, confirmation: "AUTHORIZE OFF", actorType, occurredAt });
  await append({ root, type: "ResearchSessionQuiesced", aggregateType: "research-session", aggregateId: sessionId, payload: { reason, grantRevoked: Boolean(grantId), autonomyReturnedTo: "OFF" }, actor: { type: actorType, id: humanId }, occurredAt });
  const store = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  return { appended: true, session: store.state.researchSessions[sessionId], store };
}

export async function pauseResearchMissionSession({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, sessionId, humanId = "human.browser-operator", reason = "Operator pause", occurredAt = new Date().toISOString() } = {}) {
  const loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  const session = loaded.state.researchSessions[sessionId];
  if (!session || session.status !== "active") throw new Error("mission-session-not-active");
  await append({ root, type: "ResearchSessionPaused", aggregateType: "research-session", aggregateId: sessionId, payload: { reason }, actor: { type: "human", id: humanId }, occurredAt });
  return { session: (await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root })).state.researchSessions[sessionId], store: await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root }) };
}

export async function resumeResearchMissionSession({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, sessionId, humanId = "human.browser-operator", reason = "Operator resume", occurredAt = new Date().toISOString() } = {}) {
  const loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  const session = loaded.state.researchSessions[sessionId];
  if (!session || session.status !== "paused") throw new Error("mission-session-not-paused");
  await append({ root, type: "ResearchSessionResumed", aggregateType: "research-session", aggregateId: sessionId, payload: { reason }, actor: { type: "human", id: humanId }, occurredAt });
  return { session: (await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root })).state.researchSessions[sessionId], store: await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root }) };
}

export async function stopResearchMissionSession({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, sessionId, humanId = "human.browser-operator", reason = "Operator stop", actorType = "human", occurredAt = new Date().toISOString() } = {}) {
  let loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  const session = loaded.state.researchSessions[sessionId];
  if (!session) throw new Error("mission-session-unknown");
  if (session.status === "stopped") return { appended: false, session, store: loaded };
  if (["active", "paused"].includes(session.status)) await append({ root, type: "ResearchSessionStopRequested", aggregateType: "research-session", aggregateId: sessionId, payload: { reason }, actor: { type: actorType, id: humanId }, occurredAt });
  loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  const workerIds = new Set(Object.keys(loaded.state.researchSessions[sessionId].workers));
  const openLeases = Object.entries(loaded.state.leases).filter(([, lease]) => workerIds.has(lease.agentId) && ["issued", "active"].includes(lease.status));
  for (const [leaseId] of openLeases) await revokeAgentLease({ root, leaseId, humanId, reason: `Mission ${sessionId} stopped: ${reason}`, occurredAt });
  loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  const grantId = loaded.state.researchSessions[sessionId].grantId;
  if (grantId && loaded.state.autonomy.grants[grantId]?.status === "active") await revokeBoundedAutonomyGrant({ root, grantId, humanId, reason: `Mission ${sessionId} stopped: ${reason}`, actorType, occurredAt });
  loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  if (loaded.state.autonomy.mode !== "OFF") await changeAutonomyMode({ root, to: "OFF", humanId, rationale: `Mission ${sessionId} stopped: ${reason}`, confirmation: "AUTHORIZE OFF", actorType, occurredAt });
  await append({ root, type: "ResearchSessionStopped", aggregateType: "research-session", aggregateId: sessionId, payload: { reason, revokedLeaseCount: openLeases.length, grantRevoked: Boolean(grantId), autonomyReturnedTo: "OFF", receiptHash: digest({ sessionId, reason, openLeases: openLeases.map(([id]) => id), grantId, occurredAt }) }, actor: { type: actorType, id: humanId }, occurredAt });
  return { appended: true, session: (await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root })).state.researchSessions[sessionId], store: await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root }) };
}

export async function updateMissionWorker({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, sessionId, workerId, status, currentTask = null, detail = "", occurredAt = new Date().toISOString(), actor = { type: "system", id: "mission-orchestrator-v1" } } = {}) {
  const allowed = ["standing-by", "working", "waiting-review", "needs-attention", "failed", "complete", "stopped"];
  if (!allowed.includes(status)) throw new Error("mission-worker-status-invalid");
  await append({ root, type: "ResearchSessionWorkerUpdated", aggregateType: "research-session-worker", aggregateId: workerId, payload: { sessionId, status, currentTask, detail }, actor, occurredAt });
  return { worker: (await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root })).state.researchSessions[sessionId].workers[workerId], store: await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root }) };
}

export async function stopMissionWorker({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, sessionId, workerId, humanId = "human.browser-operator", reason = "Operator stopped runner", occurredAt = new Date().toISOString() } = {}) {
  let loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  const worker = loaded.state.researchSessions[sessionId]?.workers?.[workerId];
  if (!worker) throw new Error("mission-worker-unknown");
  if (worker.status === "stopped") return { appended: false, worker, store: loaded };
  const openLeases = Object.entries(loaded.state.leases).filter(([, lease]) => lease.agentId === workerId && ["issued", "active"].includes(lease.status));
  for (const [leaseId] of openLeases) await revokeAgentLease({ root, leaseId, humanId, reason, returnTo: "eligible", occurredAt });
  await updateMissionWorker({ root, sessionId, workerId, status: "stopped", currentTask: null, detail: reason, occurredAt, actor: { type: "human", id: humanId } });
  loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  return { appended: true, worker: loaded.state.researchSessions[sessionId].workers[workerId], store: loaded };
}

export async function receiveMissionMailbox({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, sessionId, workerId, subject, summary, importance = "normal", href = null, occurredAt = new Date().toISOString() } = {}) {
  const loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  const mailboxCount = Object.values(loaded.state.researchSessions).reduce((sum, session) => sum + Object.values(session.workers || {}).reduce((workerSum, worker) => workerSum + Number(worker.mailboxCount || 0), 0), 0);
  const mailboxId = `MAIL-${String(mailboxCount + 1).padStart(4, "0")}`;
  await append({ root, type: "ResearchSessionMailboxReceived", aggregateType: "research-mail", aggregateId: mailboxId, payload: { sessionId, workerId, subject, summary, importance, href }, actor: { type: "agent", id: workerId }, occurredAt });
  return raiseResearchNotification({ root, sessionId, category: "mailbox", severity: importance === "urgent" ? "attention" : "info", title: subject, simpleExplanation: summary, whyItMatters: "A worker has placed a message in the operator mailbox.", technicalJustification: `Durable mailbox event ${mailboxId} from ${workerId}.`, links: href ? [{ label: "Open context", href }] : [], occurredAt, actor: { type: "agent", id: workerId } });
}

export async function raiseResearchNotification({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, sessionId = null, category, severity = "info", title, simpleExplanation, whyItMatters, technicalJustification, evidence = [], links = [], occurredAt = new Date().toISOString(), actor = { type: "system", id: "mission-control-v1" } } = {}) {
  if (!NOTIFICATION_SEVERITIES.includes(severity)) throw new Error("research-notification-severity-invalid");
  if (!category || !title || !simpleExplanation || !whyItMatters || !technicalJustification) throw new Error("research-notification-explanation-required");
  const loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  const id = nextId("NOTICE", Object.keys(loaded.state.notifications));
  const payload = { sessionId, category, severity, title, simpleExplanation, whyItMatters, technicalJustification, evidence, links, soundPolicy: ["significant", "error", "critical"].includes(severity) ? "loud" : severity === "attention" ? "gentle" : "silent" };
  await append({ root, type: "ResearchNotificationRaised", aggregateType: "research-notification", aggregateId: id, payload, actor, occurredAt });
  return { notificationId: id, notification: (await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root })).state.notifications[id], store: await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root }) };
}

export async function acknowledgeResearchNotification({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, notificationId, humanId = "human.browser-operator", occurredAt = new Date().toISOString() } = {}) {
  await append({ root, type: "ResearchNotificationAcknowledged", aggregateType: "research-notification", aggregateId: notificationId, payload: {}, actor: { type: "human", id: humanId }, occurredAt });
  return { notification: (await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root })).state.notifications[notificationId], store: await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root }) };
}

export async function requestHumanIntervention({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, sessionId, workerId = null, question, context, options = [], severity = "attention", occurredAt = new Date().toISOString() } = {}) {
  const loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  const id = nextId("INTERVENTION", Object.keys(loaded.state.interventions));
  await append({ root, type: "HumanInterventionRequested", aggregateType: "human-intervention", aggregateId: id, payload: { sessionId, workerId, question, context, options, severity }, actor: { type: "agent", id: workerId || "mission-orchestrator-v1" }, occurredAt });
  await raiseResearchNotification({ root, sessionId, category: "human-intervention", severity, title: question, simpleExplanation: context, whyItMatters: "The programme cannot safely choose this branch without human judgment.", technicalJustification: `Intervention ${id} is open and blocks the dependent continuation.`, links: [{ label: "Respond in Mission Control", href: `${RESEARCH_MISSION_CONTROL_ROUTE}#${id}` }], occurredAt });
  return { interventionId: id, intervention: (await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root })).state.interventions[id], store: await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root }) };
}

export async function resolveHumanIntervention({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, interventionId, decision, rationale, humanId = "human.browser-operator", occurredAt = new Date().toISOString() } = {}) {
  if (!decision || !rationale) throw new Error("human-intervention-decision-and-rationale-required");
  await append({ root, type: "HumanInterventionResolved", aggregateType: "human-intervention", aggregateId: interventionId, payload: { decision, rationale }, actor: { type: "human", id: humanId }, occurredAt });
  return { intervention: (await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root })).state.interventions[interventionId], store: await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root }) };
}

export async function publishCapabilityOpening({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, sessionId = null, sourceResultId, triggerId, effect, capability, observable, level, gates = [], gateEvidence = [], severity = "significant", links = [], occurredAt = new Date().toISOString(), actor = { type: "system", id: "capability-trigger-v1" } } = {}) {
  if (!sourceResultId || !triggerId || !effect || !capability || !observable || !level) throw new Error("capability-trigger-definition-incomplete");
  if (!["result", "significant", "critical"].includes(severity)) throw new Error("capability-trigger-severity-invalid");
  if (!Array.isArray(gates) || gates.length < 3) throw new Error("capability-trigger-gates-insufficient");
  const evidenceByGate = new Map((Array.isArray(gateEvidence) ? gateEvidence : []).map(item => [String(item.gate), item]));
  const unsatisfied = gates.filter(gate => evidenceByGate.get(gate)?.status !== "satisfied");
  if (unsatisfied.length) return { emitted: false, reason: "capability-trigger-gates-unsatisfied", unsatisfiedGates: unsatisfied };
  const loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  const duplicate = Object.values(loaded.state.notifications).find(notification => notification.category === "capability-opened" && notification.evidence?.some(item => item?.triggerId === triggerId && item?.sourceResultId === sourceResultId));
  if (duplicate) return { emitted: false, reason: "capability-trigger-already-emitted", notificationId: duplicate.id, notification: duplicate };
  const triggerEvidence = { type: "conditional-capability-trigger", triggerId, sourceResultId, level, effect, capability, observable, gates: gateEvidence };
  const notice = await raiseResearchNotification({
    root,
    sessionId,
    category: "capability-opened",
    severity,
    title: `Capability opened · ${capability}`,
    simpleExplanation: `Observed effect: ${effect}`,
    whyItMatters: `The evidence now makes “${capability}” a justified next research capability, not an established downstream technology.`,
    technicalJustification: `${triggerId} cleared ${gates.length} declared gates at ${level}; source result ${sourceResultId} remains the evidential anchor.`,
    evidence: [triggerEvidence],
    links: [{ label: "Open source result", href: `${RESEARCH_MISSION_CONTROL_ROUTE}/results/${sourceResultId}` }, ...links],
    occurredAt,
    actor,
  });
  return { emitted: true, triggerId, notificationId: notice.notificationId, notification: notice.notification, store: notice.store };
}

export async function publishResearchResult({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, sessionId, title, verdict, simpleExplanation, whyItMatters, technicalJustification, confidence = "provisional", evidence = [], links = [], capabilityOpenings = [], occurredAt = new Date().toISOString(), actor = { type: "system", id: "mission-orchestrator-v1" } } = {}) {
  const loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  const id = nextId("RESULT", Object.keys(loaded.state.publishedResults));
  const payload = { sessionId, title, verdict, simpleExplanation, whyItMatters, technicalJustification, confidence, evidence, links };
  await append({ root, type: "ResearchResultPublished", aggregateType: "research-result", aggregateId: id, payload, actor, occurredAt });
  const notice = await raiseResearchNotification({ root, sessionId, category: "new-result", severity: verdict === "significant" ? "significant" : "result", title, simpleExplanation, whyItMatters, technicalJustification, evidence, links: [{ label: "Open result", href: `${RESEARCH_MISSION_CONTROL_ROUTE}/results/${id}` }, ...links], occurredAt, actor });
  const capabilityNotifications = [];
  for (const opening of Array.isArray(capabilityOpenings) ? capabilityOpenings : []) capabilityNotifications.push(await publishCapabilityOpening({ root, sessionId, sourceResultId: id, links, occurredAt, actor, ...opening }));
  return { resultId: id, result: (await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root })).state.publishedResults[id], notificationId: notice.notificationId, capabilityNotifications, store: await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root }) };
}

export async function changeResearchTaskPriorities({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, taskIds, operation = "raise", amount = 1, value = null, rationale, cohortLabel = null, humanId = "human.browser-operator", occurredAt = new Date().toISOString() } = {}) {
  const ids = [...new Set(Array.isArray(taskIds) ? taskIds.map(String) : [])];
  if (!ids.length || ids.length > 20) throw new Error("mission-priority-task-selection-required");
  if (!rationale || String(rationale).trim().length < 4) throw new Error("mission-priority-rationale-required");
  if (!["raise", "lower", "set"].includes(operation)) throw new Error("mission-priority-operation-invalid");
  if (operation === "set" && (!Number.isInteger(value) || value < 0 || value > 100)) throw new Error("mission-priority-value-invalid");
  if (operation !== "set" && (!Number.isInteger(amount) || amount < 1 || amount > 25)) throw new Error("mission-priority-amount-invalid");
  const loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  const changes = ids.map(workItemId => {
    const item = loaded.state.workItems[workItemId];
    if (!item) throw new Error(`mission-priority-task-unknown:${workItemId}`);
    const to = operation === "set" ? value : Math.max(0, Math.min(100, item.priorityScore + (operation === "raise" ? amount : -amount)));
    return { workItemId, from: item.priorityScore, to };
  });
  if (changes.every(change => change.from === change.to)) throw new Error("mission-priority-no-change");
  const id = nextId("PRIORITY-BATCH", loaded.state.priorityBatches || []);
  const cohort = { id: `${id}-COHORT`, label: String(cohortLabel || `${ids.length} task attention cohort`).trim(), rationale: String(rationale).trim(), taskIds: ids };
  const unblockIntents = changes.filter(change => change.to > change.from && loaded.state.workItems[change.workItemId].controlStatus !== "eligible").map(change => ({ id: `${id}-UNBLOCK-${change.workItemId}`, workItemId: change.workItemId, title: `Unblock ${change.workItemId}`, reason: `Priority promotion requires its dependency or missing-middle path to be made explicit.`, sourceStatus: loaded.state.workItems[change.workItemId].sourceStatus }));
  await append({ root, type: "PriorityBatchChanged", aggregateType: "priority-batch", aggregateId: id, payload: { operation, amount: operation === "set" ? null : amount, value: operation === "set" ? value : null, reason: String(rationale).trim(), cohort, unblockIntents, changes }, actor: { type: "human", id: humanId }, occurredAt });
  const store = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  return { batchId: id, changes, unblockIntents, nextTasks: buildResearchMissionProjection(store.state).nextTasks, store };
}

export async function revertResearchPriorityBatch({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, batchId, rationale, humanId = "human.browser-operator", occurredAt = new Date().toISOString() } = {}) {
  if (!batchId || !rationale || String(rationale).trim().length < 4) throw new Error("mission-priority-revert-rationale-required");
  const loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  const batch = loaded.state.priorityBatches.find(entry => entry.id === batchId);
  if (!batch || batch.revertedBy) throw new Error("mission-priority-batch-not-revertible");
  const id = nextId("PRIORITY-REVERT", loaded.state.priorityReversions || []);
  await append({ root, type: "PriorityBatchReverted", aggregateType: "priority-reversion", aggregateId: id, payload: { batchId, reason: String(rationale).trim() }, actor: { type: "human", id: humanId }, occurredAt });
  return { reversionId: id, store: await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root }) };
}

export async function assignResearchTaskCohort({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, taskIds, streamId = null, workerIds = [], strategy = "stream-route", rationale, humanId = "human.browser-operator", occurredAt = new Date().toISOString() } = {}) {
  const ids = [...new Set(Array.isArray(taskIds) ? taskIds.map(String) : [])];
  if (!ids.length || !rationale || String(rationale).trim().length < 4) throw new Error("mission-assignment-selection-and-rationale-required");
  const loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  for (const id of ids) if (!loaded.state.workItems[id]) throw new Error(`mission-assignment-task-unknown:${id}`);
  if (streamId && !loaded.state.streams[streamId]) throw new Error(`mission-assignment-stream-unknown:${streamId}`);
  const active = Object.values(loaded.state.researchSessions).find(session => ["active", "paused"].includes(session.status));
  for (const workerId of workerIds) if (!active?.workers?.[workerId]) throw new Error(`mission-assignment-worker-unknown:${workerId}`);
  const taskScopes = Object.fromEntries(ids.map(workItemId => {
    const item = loaded.state.workItems[workItemId];
    const packet = Object.values(loaded.state.taskPackets || {}).find(candidate => candidate.workItemId === workItemId && !String(candidate.packetStatus || "").startsWith("quarantined"));
    const boundedSlice = item.controlStatus === "blocked" && Boolean(item.nextAction) && Boolean(packet);
    return [workItemId, boundedSlice ? "bounded-next-action-slice" : "programme"];
  }));
  const id = nextId("TASK-ASSIGNMENT", Object.values(loaded.state.taskAssignments || {}));
  await append({ root, type: "TaskCohortAssigned", aggregateType: "task-assignment", aggregateId: id, payload: { taskIds: ids, taskScopes, streamId, workerIds, strategy, reason: String(rationale).trim(), cohort: { label: `${ids.length} task routing cohort`, taskIds: ids } }, actor: { type: "human", id: humanId }, occurredAt });
  const activatedSliceIds = [];
  for (const workItemId of ids.filter(candidate => taskScopes[candidate] === "bounded-next-action-slice")) {
    await append({ root, type: "WorkItemTransitioned", aggregateType: "work-item", aggregateId: workItemId, payload: { from: "blocked", to: "eligible", reason: `Human-routed bounded next-action slice via ${id}`, scope: "bounded-next-action-slice", parentStatus: loaded.state.workItems[workItemId].sourceStatus }, actor: { type: "human", id: humanId }, occurredAt });
    activatedSliceIds.push(workItemId);
  }
  return { assignmentId: id, activatedSliceIds, store: await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root }) };
}

export async function saveResearchPriorityLens({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, sourceLensId, name, humanId = "human.browser-operator", occurredAt = new Date().toISOString() } = {}) {
  if (!BUILTIN_PRIORITY_LENSES.some(lens => lens.id === sourceLensId) || !name || String(name).trim().length < 3) throw new Error("mission-priority-lens-invalid");
  const loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  const id = nextId("PRIORITY-LENS", Object.keys(loaded.state.priorityLenses || {}));
  await append({ root, type: "PriorityLensSaved", aggregateType: "priority-lens", aggregateId: id, payload: { name: String(name).trim(), sourceLensId, description: `Saved view of ${sourceLensId}; viewing does not commit priority.` }, actor: { type: "human", id: humanId }, occurredAt });
  return { lensId: id, store: await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root }) };
}

export async function proposeResearchTaskPriorities({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, changes, rationale, lensId = null, agentId = "mission-priority-agent-v1", occurredAt = new Date().toISOString() } = {}) {
  if (!Array.isArray(changes) || !changes.length || !rationale) throw new Error("mission-priority-proposal-invalid");
  const loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  const normalized = changes.map(change => {
    const item = loaded.state.workItems[change.workItemId];
    if (!item || !Number.isFinite(change.to) || change.to < 0 || change.to > 100) throw new Error(`mission-priority-proposal-task-invalid:${change.workItemId}`);
    return { workItemId: change.workItemId, from: item.priorityScore, to: change.to };
  });
  const id = nextId("PRIORITY-PROPOSAL", Object.keys(loaded.state.priorityProposals || {}));
  await append({ root, type: "PriorityProposalRaised", aggregateType: "priority-proposal", aggregateId: id, payload: { changes: normalized, reason: String(rationale).trim(), lensId, cohort: { label: `${normalized.length} task agent proposal`, taskIds: normalized.map(change => change.workItemId) } }, actor: { type: "agent", id: agentId }, occurredAt });
  return { proposalId: id, store: await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root }) };
}

export async function decideResearchPriorityProposal({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, proposalId, disposition, rationale, humanId = "human.browser-operator", occurredAt = new Date().toISOString() } = {}) {
  if (!["approve", "reject", "defer"].includes(disposition) || !rationale || String(rationale).trim().length < 4) throw new Error("mission-priority-proposal-decision-invalid");
  const loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  if (!loaded.state.priorityProposals[proposalId]) throw new Error("mission-priority-proposal-unknown");
  const decisionCount = Object.values(loaded.state.priorityProposals).filter(proposal => proposal.disposition).length;
  const id = `PRIORITY-PROPOSAL-DECISION-${String(decisionCount + 1).padStart(4, "0")}`;
  await append({ root, type: "PriorityProposalDispositionRecorded", aggregateType: "priority-proposal-decision", aggregateId: id, payload: { proposalId, disposition, reason: String(rationale).trim() }, actor: { type: "human", id: humanId }, occurredAt });
  return { decisionId: id, store: await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root }) };
}

export async function reconcileStoppingResearchSessions({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, occurredAt = new Date().toISOString() } = {}) {
  const loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  const stopping = Object.values(loaded.state.researchSessions).filter(session => session.status === "stopping");
  const reconciled = [];
  for (const session of stopping) {
    await stopResearchMissionSession({ root, sessionId: session.id, humanId: session.stopRequestedBy || session.startedBy, reason: "Restart recovery completed an interrupted stop", occurredAt });
    reconciled.push(session.id);
  }
  return { reconciled, store: await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root }) };
}

export async function reconcileResearchUnblockTasks({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, actor = { type: "system", id: "unblock-reconciliation-v1" }, occurredAt = new Date().toISOString() } = {}) {
  let loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  const open = Object.values(loaded.state.unblockTasks || {}).filter(task => task.status === "open").sort((left, right) => String(left.createdAt).localeCompare(String(right.createdAt)) || left.id.localeCompare(right.id));
  const retainedTargets = new Set();
  const resolved = [];
  for (const task of open) {
    loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
    const current = loaded.state.unblockTasks?.[task.id];
    if (!current || current.status !== "open") continue;
    const item = loaded.state.workItems?.[task.workItemId];
    let resolution = null;
    if (!item) resolution = "target-missing";
    else if (["eligible", "leased", "running", "reviewing", "closed"].includes(item.controlStatus)) resolution = `target-${item.controlStatus}`;
    else if (retainedTargets.has(task.workItemId)) resolution = "duplicate-open-obligation";
    else retainedTargets.add(task.workItemId);
    if (!resolution) continue;
    await append({ root, type: "ResearchUnblockTaskResolved", aggregateType: "research-unblock-task", aggregateId: task.id, payload: { unblockTaskId: task.id, workItemId: task.workItemId, resolution }, actor, occurredAt });
    resolved.push({ id: task.id, workItemId: task.workItemId, resolution });
  }
  return { resolved, store: await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root }) };
}

export async function continueVerifiedResearch({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, runId = null, actor = { type: "system", id: "verified-continuation-policy-v1" }, occurredAt = new Date().toISOString() } = {}) {
  let loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  const candidates = Object.values(loaded.state.executionRuns).filter(run => (!runId || run.id === runId) && run.status === "reviewing").filter(run => {
    const review = Object.entries(loaded.state.reviews).filter(([, entry]) => entry.runId === run.id && entry.status === "completed").at(-1)?.[1];
    return ["verification-pass-awaiting-human-scientific-outcome", "artifact-integrity-pass-ready-for-activity-fanout"].includes(review?.result?.verdict) && !loaded.state.continuations.some(entry => entry.runId === run.id);
  });
  const promoted = [];
  for (const run of candidates) {
    loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
    const item = loaded.state.workItems[run.workItemId];
    const reviewEntry = Object.entries(loaded.state.reviews).filter(([, entry]) => entry.runId === run.id && entry.status === "completed").at(-1);
    if (!item || !reviewEntry) continue;
    const [reviewId, review] = reviewEntry;
    const continuationAttempt = Number(item.continuationAttempt || 1) + 1;
    const terminal = continuationAttempt > 3;
    let packet = null;
    if (!terminal) {
      const parentPacket = loaded.state.taskPackets[run.packetId];
      packet = compileResearchContinuationPacket({ parentPacket, parentItem: item, parentRun: run, review: { id: reviewId, ...review }, continuationAttempt });
      await freezeCompiledTaskPacket({ root, packet, occurredAt });
    }
    const continuationId = `CONT-${String(loaded.state.continuations.length + 1).padStart(4, "0")}`;
    const nextAction = terminal
      ? `Bounded route exhausted after three independently verified passes; retain an explicit reopen condition and preserve the underlying claim as unresolved.`
      : packet.question;
    await append({ root, type: "VerifiedResearchContinuationScheduled", aggregateType: "continuation", aggregateId: continuationId, payload: { runId: run.id, reviewId, workItemId: item.id, packetId: packet?.id || null, from: "reviewing", to: terminal ? "closed" : "eligible", continuationAttempt: terminal ? 3 : continuationAttempt, nextAction, reason: terminal ? "Three bounded passes completed without a further safe local continuation; claim truth remains unjudged." : "Independent integrity review passed; continue through the next bounded missing-middle pass without a human scientific verdict.", status: terminal ? "exhausted-with-reopen-condition" : "eligible", executionAuthorized: false }, actor, occurredAt });
    promoted.push({ runId: run.id, workItemId: item.id, continuationId, packetId: packet?.id || null, terminal });
  }
  return { promoted, store: await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root }) };
}

export async function expandResearchTaskActivities({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, workItemIds = null, actor = { type: "system", id: "research-activity-generator-v0.1" }, occurredAt = new Date().toISOString() } = {}) {
  let loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  const selected = Object.values(loaded.state.workItems).filter(item => !item.parentWorkItemId && (!workItemIds || workItemIds.includes(item.id))).filter(item => !Object.values(loaded.state.researchActivities || {}).some(activity => activity.parentWorkItemId === item.id));
  const generated = [];
  for (const parent of selected) {
    loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
    const parentPacket = Object.values(loaded.state.taskPackets).filter(packet => packet.workItemId === parent.id).sort((a, b) => Number(b.continuationAttempt || 1) - Number(a.continuationAttempt || 1))[0];
    if (!parentPacket) continue;
    const field = classifyResearchField(parent);
    const stem = parent.id.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9-]/g, "-");
    const base = { parentWorkItemId: parent.id, streamId: parent.streamId, sourceRoute: parent.sourceRoute, sourceStatus: "activity-of-parent", priorityScore: Math.max(1, parent.priorityScore - 1), researchFieldId: field.id };
    const activities = [
      { ...base, id: `${stem}-A-EVIDENCE`, title: `Evidence map · ${parent.title}`, kind: "evidence-gap-and-source-lineage", activityType: "evidence", controlStatus: "eligible", dependencyIds: [], nextAction: `Interrogate the frozen corpus for ${parent.id}: enumerate supporting and contrary evidence, unresolved source identities, acquisition needs, and the precise claim each source could change.` },
      { ...base, id: `${stem}-A-FORMAL`, title: `Formal discriminator · ${parent.title}`, kind: "formal-model-proof-or-measurement-audit", activityType: "formal-analysis", controlStatus: "eligible", dependencyIds: [], nextAction: `Choose the strongest domain-appropriate formal route for ${parent.id} and carry it far enough to expose a calculation, proof obligation, dimensional inconsistency, model discriminator, or executable data specification.` },
      { ...base, id: `${stem}-A-RIVAL`, title: `Adversarial rival · ${parent.title}`, kind: "counterexample-null-and-rival-analysis", activityType: "adversarial", controlStatus: "eligible", dependencyIds: [], nextAction: `Construct the strongest rival account, null model, counterexample, or conventional explanation for ${parent.id}; name an observation that separates it from the focal path.` },
    ];
    const dependencies = activities.map(activity => activity.id);
    activities.push({ ...base, id: `${stem}-A-SYNTHESIS`, title: `Evidence synthesis · ${parent.title}`, kind: "cross-activity-synthesis-and-next-branch", activityType: "synthesis", controlStatus: "blocked", dependencyIds: dependencies, nextAction: `Combine the evidence, formal, and adversarial activity outputs for ${parent.id}; state what changed, what remains unresolved, and the next evidence-bearing branch without issuing a truth verdict.` });
    const planId = `ACTIVITY-PLAN-${String(Math.floor(Object.keys(loaded.state.researchActivities || {}).length / 4) + 1).padStart(4, "0")}`;
    await append({ root, type: "ResearchActivitiesGenerated", aggregateType: "research-activity-plan", aggregateId: planId, payload: { parentWorkItemId: parent.id, minimumActivities: 2, activities, reason: "A research task must contain multiple independently reviewable activities and an explicit synthesis dependency." }, actor, occurredAt });
    for (const activity of activities) await freezeCompiledTaskPacket({ root, packet: compileResearchActivityPacket({ parentPacket, parentItem: parent, activity }), occurredAt });
    generated.push({ parentWorkItemId: parent.id, planId, activityIds: activities.map(activity => activity.id) });
  }
  return { generated, store: await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root }) };
}

export async function queueResearchDecompositionJobs({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, runIds = null, actor = { type: "system", id: "decomposition-queue-router-v0.1" }, occurredAt = new Date().toISOString() } = {}) {
  let loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  const latestByWorkItem = new Map();
  for (const run of Object.values(loaded.state.executionRuns || {})) {
    if (runIds && !runIds.includes(run.id)) continue;
    if (!["closed", "reviewing", "continued"].includes(run.status) || !run.steps?.length) continue;
    const packet = loaded.state.taskPackets?.[run.packetId];
    if (!packet?.requiredInputs?.length || packet.taskClass === "research-outcome-atomic-decomposition" || packet.atomicClaim) continue;
    const prior = latestByWorkItem.get(run.workItemId);
    if (!prior || run.id.localeCompare(prior.id) > 0) latestByWorkItem.set(run.workItemId, run);
  }
  const queued = [];
  const existingJobIds = new Set(Object.keys(loaded.state.workItems || {}));
  const decomposedRunIds = new Set(Object.values(loaded.state.researchDecompositions || {}).map(entry => entry.runId));
  for (const run of latestByWorkItem.values()) {
    const jobId = `DECOMP-${run.id}`;
    if (decomposedRunIds.has(run.id)) continue;
    const parentItem = loaded.state.workItems?.[run.workItemId];
    const parentPacket = loaded.state.taskPackets?.[run.packetId];
    if (!parentItem || !parentPacket) continue;
    const packet = compileResearchDecompositionPacket({ parentPacket, parentItem, sourceRun: run });
    const snapshot = { id: jobId, title: packet.title, kind: "non-atomic-result-decomposition", sourceStatus: "queued-from-non-atomic-report", sourceRoute: `/research-control-plane/mission/reports/${run.id}`, priorityScore: Math.max(1, Number(parentItem.priorityScore || 1) + 1), executionEligible: true, sourceRunId: run.id, sourceWorkItemId: parentItem.id, nextAction: packet.question };
    if (!existingJobIds.has(jobId)) {
      try {
        await append({ root, type: "WorkItemImported", aggregateType: "work-item", aggregateId: jobId, payload: { streamId: parentItem.streamId, inboxId: parentItem.inboxId, adapterId: "decomposition-queue-router-v0.1", sourceFingerprint: digest({ runId: run.id, packetHash: parentPacket.packetHash }), controlStatus: "eligible", snapshot }, actor, occurredAt });
      } catch (error) {
        const refreshed = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
        if (!refreshed.state.workItems?.[jobId]) throw error;
      }
    }
    const refreshed = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
    const packetExists = Object.values(refreshed.state.taskPackets || {}).some(candidate => candidate.workItemId === jobId);
    if (!packetExists) await freezeCompiledTaskPacket({ root, packet, occurredAt });
    existingJobIds.add(jobId);
    queued.push({ jobId, sourceRunId: run.id, sourceWorkItemId: parentItem.id, expectedMinimumComponentCount: parentPacket.requiredInputs.length + 1 });
  }
  return { queued, store: await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root }) };
}

export async function applyReviewedResearchDecomposition({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, runId, reviewId, decomposition, actor = { type: "system", id: "decomposition-materializer-v0.1" }, occurredAt = new Date().toISOString() } = {}) {
  const loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  const run = loaded.state.executionRuns?.[runId];
  const review = loaded.state.reviews?.[reviewId];
  const job = run && loaded.state.workItems?.[run.workItemId];
  const packet = run && loaded.state.taskPackets?.[run.packetId];
  if (!run || !review || review.status !== "completed" || review.runId !== runId || review.result?.verdict !== "artifact-integrity-pass-decomposition-valid") throw new Error(`decomposition-review-not-valid:${runId}`);
  if (job?.kind !== "non-atomic-result-decomposition" || !packet?.source?.sourceWorkItemId) throw new Error(`decomposition-job-invalid:${runId}`);
  const sourceParent = loaded.state.workItems?.[packet.source.sourceWorkItemId];
  if (!sourceParent) throw new Error(`decomposition-source-parent-missing:${packet.source.sourceWorkItemId}`);
  const base = { parentWorkItemId: sourceParent.id, streamId: sourceParent.streamId, sourceRoute: sourceParent.sourceRoute, sourceStatus: "atomic-child-of-reviewed-decomposition", priorityScore: Math.max(1, Number(sourceParent.priorityScore || 1)), researchFieldId: classifyResearchField(sourceParent).id, decompositionSourceRunId: packet.source.sourceRunId };
  const activities = decomposition.map((component, index) => ({ ...base, id: `${sourceParent.id}-${packet.source.sourceRunId}-D${String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}`, title: component.statement, kind: "atomic-research-claim", activityType: "atomic-claim", controlStatus: component.disposition === "unresolved" ? "blocked" : "eligible", dependencyIds: component.disposition === "unresolved" ? component.unresolvedInputs.map(input => `UNRESOLVED:${digest(input).slice(0, 12)}`) : [], nextAction: component.disposition === "unresolved" ? component.nextAction : `Independently verify the ${component.disposition} disposition and cited evidence.`, atomicClaim: structuredClone(component) }));
  await append({ root, type: "ResearchDecompositionApplied", aggregateType: "research-decomposition", aggregateId: `DECOMP-APPLIED-${packet.source.sourceRunId}`, payload: { jobRunId: runId, reviewId, jobWorkItemId: job.id, sourceRunId: packet.source.sourceRunId, parentWorkItemId: sourceParent.id, activities, decomposition }, actor, occurredAt });
  for (const activity of activities) await freezeCompiledTaskPacket({ root, packet: compileResearchActivityPacket({ parentPacket: loaded.state.taskPackets[packet.source.sourcePacketId], parentItem: sourceParent, activity }), occurredAt });
  return { parentWorkItemId: sourceParent.id, activityIds: activities.map(activity => activity.id), store: await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root }) };
}

export async function completeVerifiedResearchActivity({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, runId, actor = { type: "system", id: "research-activity-completion-v0.1" }, occurredAt = new Date().toISOString() } = {}) {
  const loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
  const run = loaded.state.executionRuns[runId];
  const item = run ? loaded.state.workItems[run.workItemId] : null;
  const reviewEntry = Object.entries(loaded.state.reviews).filter(([, review]) => review.runId === runId && review.status === "completed").at(-1);
  if (!run || !item?.parentWorkItemId || !reviewEntry || reviewEntry[1].result?.verdict !== "artifact-integrity-and-flow-pass") throw new Error(`research-activity-not-completable:${runId}`);
  const [reviewId] = reviewEntry;
  const completionId = `ACTIVITY-COMPLETION-${String(Object.values(loaded.state.researchActivities || {}).filter(activity => activity.status === "complete").length + 1).padStart(4, "0")}`;
  await append({ root, type: "VerifiedResearchActivityCompleted", aggregateType: "research-activity-completion", aggregateId: completionId, payload: { runId, reviewId, activityId: item.id, parentWorkItemId: item.parentWorkItemId, artifactCount: run.steps.length, reason: "Artifact integrity, reviewer separation, activity fanout and successor visibility all passed." }, actor, occurredAt });
  return { completionId, activityId: item.id, parentWorkItemId: item.parentWorkItemId, store: await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root }) };
}

export function findRecoverableBlockedResearchActivities(state, { maximumInterruptedAttempts = 3 } = {}) {
  const packets = Object.values(state.taskPackets || {});
  const leases = Object.values(state.leases || {});
  const activities = Object.values(state.researchActivities || {});
  const unresolvedRecoveryParents = new Set();
  const activityCandidates = activities.sort((a, b) => String(a.id).localeCompare(String(b.id))).flatMap(activity => {
    const item = state.workItems?.[activity.id];
    if (!item || item.controlStatus !== "blocked" || item.lastTransition?.scope === "repeated-timeout-stall-containment") return [];
    if (activity.status === "complete") return [];
    // Once an activity has been decomposed, its children are the only valid
    // continuation. Re-enabling the blocked parent recursively re-runs the
    // same non-atomic path and causes every exhaustion sweep to rediscover it.
    if (activities.some(candidate => candidate.parentWorkItemId === item.id)) return [];
    const dependencyIds = item.dependencyIds || activity.dependencyIds || [];
    const unresolvedDecompositionSlice = item.sourceStatus === "atomic-child-of-reviewed-decomposition"
      && item.atomicClaim?.disposition === "unresolved"
      && dependencyIds.length > 0
      && dependencyIds.every(id => String(id).startsWith("UNRESOLVED:"));
    let dependenciesComplete = dependencyIds.every(id => state.workItems?.[id]?.controlStatus === "closed");
    if (unresolvedDecompositionSlice) {
      const parentId = item.parentWorkItemId;
      const siblings = activities.map(candidate => state.workItems?.[candidate.id]).filter(candidate => candidate?.parentWorkItemId === parentId);
      const siblingInFlight = siblings.some(candidate => candidate.id !== item.id && ["eligible", "leased", "running", "reviewing"].includes(candidate.controlStatus));
      const earlierBlockedSibling = siblings.filter(candidate => candidate.sourceStatus === "atomic-child-of-reviewed-decomposition" && candidate.atomicClaim?.disposition === "unresolved" && candidate.controlStatus === "blocked").sort((a, b) => String(a.id).localeCompare(String(b.id)))[0];
      const hasClosedSibling = siblings.some(candidate => candidate.controlStatus === "closed");
      dependenciesComplete = Boolean(parentId)
        && state.workItems?.[parentId]?.controlStatus === "blocked"
        && hasClosedSibling
        && !siblingInFlight
        && earlierBlockedSibling?.id === item.id
        && !unresolvedRecoveryParents.has(parentId);
      if (dependenciesComplete) unresolvedRecoveryParents.add(parentId);
    }
    if (!dependenciesComplete) return [];
    const packet = packets.find(candidate => candidate.workItemId === item.id && !String(candidate.packetStatus || "").startsWith("quarantined"));
    if (!packet) return [];
    if (leases.some(lease => lease.workItemId === item.id && ["issued", "active"].includes(lease.status))) return [];
    const interruptedAttempts = leases.filter(lease => lease.workItemId === item.id && ["revoked", "expired"].includes(lease.status)).length;
    if (interruptedAttempts >= maximumInterruptedAttempts) return [];
    return [{
      id: item.id,
      parentWorkItemId: item.parentWorkItemId,
      dependencyIds,
      interruptedAttempts,
      retryStage: interruptedAttempts === 0 ? "first-chance-recovery" : interruptedAttempts === 1 ? "second-chance" : "third-chance",
      reason: dependencyIds.length
        ? unresolvedDecompositionSlice
          ? "The prior reviewed-decomposition sibling is closed; unlock this bounded unresolved-input slice without resolving its claim or closing its blocked parent."
          : "All declared dependencies are closed but the successor remained blocked."
        : "A dependency-free research activity was blocked by an interrupted execution rather than a scientific terminal verdict.",
    }];
  });
  const interruptedDecompositionJobs = Object.values(state.workItems || {}).filter(item => item.kind === "non-atomic-result-decomposition" && item.controlStatus === "blocked").flatMap(item => {
    const packet = packets.find(candidate => candidate.workItemId === item.id && !String(candidate.packetStatus || "").startsWith("quarantined"));
    if (!packet) return [];
    if (leases.some(lease => lease.workItemId === item.id && ["issued", "active"].includes(lease.status))) return [];
    const interruptedAttempts = leases.filter(lease => lease.workItemId === item.id && ["revoked", "expired"].includes(lease.status)).length;
    if (interruptedAttempts === 0 || interruptedAttempts >= maximumInterruptedAttempts) return [];
    if (Object.values(state.researchDecompositions || {}).some(entry => entry.sourceRunId === item.sourceRunId || entry.runId === item.sourceRunId)) return [];
    return [{
      id: item.id,
      parentWorkItemId: item.sourceWorkItemId || null,
      dependencyIds: [],
      interruptedAttempts,
      retryStage: interruptedAttempts === 1 ? "second-chance" : "third-chance",
      reason: "The prior local decomposition attempt was interrupted by an execution failure; its frozen packet remains valid and no active lease or completed decomposition exists.",
    }];
  });
  return [...activityCandidates, ...interruptedDecompositionJobs].sort((left, right) => String(left.id).localeCompare(String(right.id)));
}

export async function reconcilePrematurelyClosedDecompositionParents({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, occurredAt = new Date().toISOString(), actor = { type: "watchdog", id: "research-flow-recovery-v1" }, candidateIds = null } = {}) {
  const selectedIds = candidateIds ? new Set(candidateIds) : null;
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 24; attempt += 1) {
    const loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
    const parentIds = [...new Set(Object.values(loaded.state.workItems || {}).filter(item => {
      if (selectedIds && !selectedIds.has(item.id)) return false;
      return item.controlStatus === "blocked"
        && item.sourceStatus === "atomic-child-of-reviewed-decomposition"
        && item.atomicClaim?.disposition === "unresolved"
        && item.parentWorkItemId
        && loaded.state.workItems?.[item.parentWorkItemId]?.controlStatus === "closed";
    }).map(item => item.parentWorkItemId))].sort();
    if (!parentIds.length) return { reopened: [], store: loaded };
    const events = parentIds.flatMap((parentId, index) => {
      const firstSequence = loaded.checkpoint.sequence + (index * 2) + 1;
      const common = {
        reason: "A reviewed decomposition still has unresolved child activities; restore the parent as blocked until every declared child is terminal.",
        scope: "decomposition-parent-terminal-reconciliation",
        preservesProvenance: true,
      };
      return [
        createKernelEvent({ sequence: firstSequence, eventId: `RCPK-${String(firstSequence).padStart(4, "0")}`, type: "WorkItemTransitioned", aggregate: { type: "work-item", id: parentId }, payload: { from: "closed", to: "eligible", ...common }, actor, occurredAt }),
        createKernelEvent({ sequence: firstSequence + 1, eventId: `RCPK-${String(firstSequence + 1).padStart(4, "0")}`, type: "WorkItemTransitioned", aggregate: { type: "work-item", id: parentId }, payload: { from: "eligible", to: "blocked", ...common }, actor, occurredAt }),
      ];
    });
    try {
      await appendResearchControlPlaneEvents({ root, events });
      return { reopened: parentIds, store: await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root }) };
    } catch (error) {
      const conflicted = error.message.startsWith("event-id-conflict:") || error.message.startsWith("event-sequence:") || error.message === "kernel-store-writer-busy";
      if (!conflicted || attempt === 23) throw error;
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, Math.min(250, 25 * (attempt + 1))));
    }
  }
  throw new Error("decomposition-parent-reconciliation-retry-exhausted");
}

export async function recoverRetryableResearchActivities({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, occurredAt = new Date().toISOString(), actor = { type: "watchdog", id: "research-flow-recovery-v1" }, candidateIds = null } = {}) {
  await reconcilePrematurelyClosedDecompositionParents({ root, occurredAt, actor, candidateIds });
  const selectedIds = candidateIds ? new Set(candidateIds) : null;
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 24; attempt += 1) {
    const loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
    const candidates = findRecoverableBlockedResearchActivities(loaded.state).filter(candidate => !selectedIds || selectedIds.has(candidate.id));
    if (!candidates.length) return { recovered: [], store: loaded };
    const events = candidates.map((candidate, index) => createKernelEvent({
      sequence: loaded.checkpoint.sequence + index + 1,
      eventId: `RCPK-${String(loaded.checkpoint.sequence + index + 1).padStart(4, "0")}`,
      type: "WorkItemTransitioned",
      aggregate: { type: "work-item", id: candidate.id },
      payload: {
        from: "blocked",
        to: "eligible",
        reason: `${candidate.reason} Restore as ${candidate.retryStage} while retaining every prior lease, run and artifact.`,
        scope: "bounded-research-activity-recovery",
        retryStage: candidate.retryStage,
        interruptedAttempts: candidate.interruptedAttempts,
        preservesProvenance: true,
      },
      actor,
      occurredAt,
    }));
    try {
      await appendResearchControlPlaneEvents({ root, events });
      return { recovered: candidates, store: await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root }) };
    } catch (error) {
      const conflicted = error.message.startsWith("event-id-conflict:") || error.message.startsWith("event-sequence:") || error.message === "kernel-store-writer-busy";
      if (!conflicted || attempt === 23) throw error;
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, Math.min(250, 25 * (attempt + 1))));
    }
  }
  throw new Error("research-activity-recovery-retry-exhausted");
}

export async function reconcileResearchMissionProcessContradictions({ root = DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE_ROOT, occurredAt = new Date().toISOString(), actor = { type: "system", id: "mission-process-reconciliation-v1" } } = {}) {
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 24; attempt += 1) {
    const loaded = await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root });
    const completableAnalyses = (loaded.state.rootCauseAnalyses || []).filter(analysis => analysis.fiveWhysStatus !== "completed" && String(analysis.id).startsWith("RCA-MISSION-")).flatMap(analysis => {
      const continuation = (loaded.state.continuations || []).find(candidate => candidate.rcaId === analysis.id && candidate.status === "completed");
      const remedy = continuation ? loaded.state.workItems?.[continuation.workItemId] : null;
      return continuation && remedy?.controlStatus === "closed" ? [{ analysis, continuation, remedy }] : [];
    });
    const staleTerminalActivities = Object.values(loaded.state.researchActivities || {}).filter(activity => {
      const item = loaded.state.workItems?.[activity.id];
      return activity.status === "complete" && item && item.controlStatus !== "closed";
    });
    if (!staleTerminalActivities.length && !completableAnalyses.length) return { reconciled: [], completedAnalyses: [], incident: null, store: loaded };
    if (!staleTerminalActivities.length) {
      const events = completableAnalyses.map(({ analysis, continuation, remedy }, index) => createKernelEvent({
        sequence: loaded.checkpoint.sequence + index + 1,
        eventId: `RCPK-${String(loaded.checkpoint.sequence + index + 1).padStart(4, "0")}`,
        type: "RootCauseAnalysisCompleted",
        aggregate: { type: "root-cause-analysis", id: analysis.id },
        payload: { continuationId: continuation.id, remediationWorkItemId: remedy.id, verification: "remedy-closed-and-projection-reconciled" },
        actor,
        occurredAt,
      }));
      try {
        await appendResearchControlPlaneEvents({ root, events });
        return { reconciled: [], completedAnalyses: completableAnalyses.map(({ analysis }) => analysis.id), incident: null, store: await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root }) };
      } catch (error) {
        const conflicted = error.message.startsWith("event-id-conflict:") || error.message.startsWith("event-sequence:") || error.message === "kernel-store-writer-busy";
        if (!conflicted || attempt === 23) throw error;
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, Math.min(250, 25 * (attempt + 1))));
        continue;
      }
    }
    const signature = digest(staleTerminalActivities.map(activity => [activity.id, loaded.state.workItems[activity.id].controlStatus]).sort());
    const failureId = `FAIL-MISSION-${signature.slice(0, 12)}`;
    if ((loaded.state.failures || []).some(failure => failure.id === failureId)) return { reconciled: [], incident: failureId, store: loaded };
    const rcaId = `RCA-MISSION-${signature.slice(0, 12)}`;
    const remedyId = `REMEDY-MISSION-${signature.slice(0, 12)}`;
    const continuationId = `CONT-MISSION-${signature.slice(0, 12)}`;
    const definitions = [
      ["FailureRecorded", "failure", failureId, { message: `Mission projection found ${staleTerminalActivities.length} completed research activities still exposed as actionable work.`, classification: "process", terminal: false, invariant: "terminal-activity-not-actionable", affectedWorkItemIds: staleTerminalActivities.map(activity => activity.id) }],
      ["RootCauseAnalysisOpened", "root-cause-analysis", rcaId, { failureId, classification: "process", fiveWhysStatus: "open", immediateContainment: "exclude terminal activities from scheduler and Mission Control action lanes", requiresProcessReview: true, rootCause: "research activity completion and work-item control status diverged" }],
      ["WorkItemImported", "work-item", remedyId, { streamId: "STR-META", inboxId: "INBOX-META", adapterId: "mission-process-reconciliation-v1", sourceFingerprint: signature, controlStatus: "eligible", snapshot: { id: remedyId, title: "Reconcile terminal research activity control states", kind: "process-remediation", sourceStatus: "control-plane-contradiction", priorityScore: 30, executionEligible: true, nextAction: "Close stale actionable projections for completed activities and verify scheduler/UI agreement.", sourceRoute: RESEARCH_MISSION_CONTROL_ROUTE, researchFieldId: "meta-research" } }],
      ...staleTerminalActivities.map(activity => ["WorkItemTransitioned", "work-item", activity.id, { from: loaded.state.workItems[activity.id].controlStatus, to: "closed", reason: `Process remediation ${remedyId}: the durable research activity is already complete.`, scope: "control-plane-state-reconciliation", preservesProvenance: true }]),
      ["WorkItemTransitioned", "work-item", remedyId, { from: "eligible", to: "closed", reason: "Terminal activity and work-item states reconciled and projection agreement verified.", scope: "process-remediation-complete", preservesProvenance: true }],
      ["ContinuationCreated", "continuation", continuationId, { failureId, rcaId, workItemId: remedyId, destination: "STR-META", kind: "typed-remediation", status: "completed", executionAuthorized: false, preservesProvenance: true }],
      ["RootCauseAnalysisCompleted", "root-cause-analysis", rcaId, { continuationId, remediationWorkItemId: remedyId, verification: "remedy-closed-and-projection-reconciled" }],
    ];
    const events = definitions.map(([type, aggregateType, aggregateId, payload], index) => createKernelEvent({
      sequence: loaded.checkpoint.sequence + index + 1,
      eventId: `RCPK-${String(loaded.checkpoint.sequence + index + 1).padStart(4, "0")}`,
      type,
      aggregate: { type: aggregateType, id: aggregateId },
      payload,
      actor,
      occurredAt,
    }));
    try {
      await appendResearchControlPlaneEvents({ root, events });
      return { reconciled: staleTerminalActivities.map(activity => activity.id), incident: failureId, remediationWorkItemId: remedyId, store: await loadResearchControlPlaneStore({ root }) };
    } catch (error) {
      const conflicted = error.message.startsWith("event-id-conflict:") || error.message.startsWith("event-sequence:") || error.message === "kernel-store-writer-busy";
      if (!conflicted || attempt === 23) throw error;
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, Math.min(250, 25 * (attempt + 1))));
    }
  }
  throw new Error("mission-process-reconciliation-retry-exhausted");
}

export function buildResearchMissionProjection(state) {
  const sessions = Object.values(state.researchSessions || {}).sort((a, b) => b.startedAt.localeCompare(a.startedAt));
  const activeSession = sessions.find(session => ["active", "paused", "stopping"].includes(session.status)) || null;
  const activeGrant = activeSession?.grantId ? state.autonomy.grants?.[activeSession.grantId] || null : null;
  const notifications = Object.values(state.notifications || {}).sort((a, b) => b.raisedAt.localeCompare(a.raisedAt));
  const interventions = Object.values(state.interventions || {}).sort((a, b) => b.requestedAt.localeCompare(a.requestedAt));
  const results = Object.values(state.publishedResults || {}).sort((a, b) => b.publishedAt.localeCompare(a.publishedAt));
  const packetByWorkItem = new Map(Object.values(state.taskPackets || {}).map(packet => [packet.workItemId, packet]));
  const runnablePacketByWorkItem = new Map(Object.values(state.taskPackets || {}).filter(packet => !String(packet.packetStatus || "").startsWith("quarantined")).map(packet => [packet.workItemId, packet]));
  const primaryResearchHref = sourceItem => {
    let item = sourceItem;
    const visited = new Set();
    while (item && !visited.has(item.id)) {
      visited.add(item.id);
      const route = String(item.sourceRoute || "");
      if (route && !route.startsWith(`${RESEARCH_MISSION_CONTROL_ROUTE}/reports/`)) return route;
      const packet = packetByWorkItem.get(item.id);
      const sourceWorkItemId = packet?.source?.sourceWorkItemId || packet?.compiler?.sourceWorkItemId || item.parentWorkItemId;
      item = sourceWorkItemId ? state.workItems?.[sourceWorkItemId] : null;
    }
    return `/research-inbox#${encodeURIComponent(sourceItem?.id || "research")}`;
  };
  const reports = Object.values(state.executionRuns || {}).filter(run => run.steps?.length && run.status !== "running").sort((a, b) => String(b.completedAt || b.closedAt || b.openedAt).localeCompare(String(a.completedAt || a.closedAt || a.openedAt))).map(run => {
    const item = state.workItems?.[run.workItemId];
    const packet = state.taskPackets?.[run.packetId];
    const review = Object.values(state.reviews || {}).filter(entry => entry.runId === run.id).at(-1) || null;
    const outcome = (state.researchOutcomes || []).find(entry => entry.runId === run.id) || null;
    const legacyNonAtomicScaffold = !outcome && Boolean(packet) && run.steps.some(step => ["P5", "READINESS"].includes(step.phaseId) || (/^STAGE_[0-4]$/u.test(step.phaseId) && packet.protocol === "claimipedia-materials-deep-research-compiler/1.0"));
    const claimipediaHref = primaryResearchHref(item || { id: run.workItemId });
    return {
      id: run.id,
      workItemId: run.workItemId,
      title: item?.title || run.workItemId,
      status: run.status,
      completedAt: run.completedAt || run.closedAt || null,
      stepCount: run.steps.length,
      reviewStatus: review?.status || (run.status === "reviewing" ? "awaiting-review" : ["revoked", "expired"].includes(run.status) ? "interrupted" : "not-requested"),
