      outcome: outcome?.verdict || (legacyNonAtomicScaffold ? "decomposition-required" : null),
      outcomeSource: outcome ? "recorded-scientific-outcome" : legacyNonAtomicScaffold ? "inferred-from-legacy-scaffold" : null,
      atomic: outcome?.verdict === "partial" || legacyNonAtomicScaffold ? false : outcome?.atomic ?? null,
      terminal: outcome?.verdict === "partial" || legacyNonAtomicScaffold ? false : outcome?.terminal ?? null,
      decompositionCount: outcome?.decomposition?.length || (legacyNonAtomicScaffold ? new Set(packet.requiredInputs || []).size + 1 : 0),
      dispositionClass: outcome?.verdict === "decomposition-required" ? "non-atomic-open" : outcome?.verdict === "partial" || legacyNonAtomicScaffold ? "legacy-partial-requires-decomposition" : outcome?.verdict || "not-adjudicated",
      href: claimipediaHref,
      receiptHref: `${RESEARCH_MISSION_CONTROL_ROUTE}/reports/${encodeURIComponent(run.id)}`,
    };
  });
  const latestReportByWorkItem = new Map(reports.map(report => [report.workItemId, report]));
  const effectiveUnblockTasks = [];
  const unblockTargets = new Set();
  for (const task of Object.values(state.unblockTasks || {}).filter(task => task.status === "open").sort((left, right) => String(left.createdAt).localeCompare(String(right.createdAt)) || left.id.localeCompare(right.id))) {
    const item = state.workItems?.[task.workItemId];
    if (!item || ["eligible", "leased", "running", "reviewing", "closed"].includes(item.controlStatus) || unblockTargets.has(task.workItemId)) continue;
    unblockTargets.add(task.workItemId);
    effectiveUnblockTasks.push(task);
  }
  const rotation = orderResearchWorkItemsFieldFair(Object.values(state.workItems || {}), state);
  // Closed work belongs in the report/history surfaces, never in an action
  // lane.  Treating a closed high-priority record as "Remedy" manufactured a
  // human/policy blocker after its decomposition or activity flow had already
  // completed.
  const ranked = rotation.ordered.filter(item => item.controlStatus !== "closed" && state.researchActivities?.[item.id]?.status !== "complete");
  const highCut = ranked.length ? Math.max(20, ranked[Math.max(0, Math.ceil(ranked.length / 2) - 1)].priorityScore) : 20;
  const latestTimestamp = [state.autonomy?.changedAt, ...sessions.map(entry => entry.startedAt), ...Object.values(state.notifications || {}).map(entry => entry.raisedAt)].filter(Boolean).sort().at(-1) || new Date().toISOString();
  const now = new Date(latestTimestamp).getTime();
  const selectedCounts = new Map();
  for (const decision of state.shadowDecisions || []) {
    const selected = decision.selectedItemId || decision.workItemId;
    if (selected) selectedCounts.set(selected, (selectedCounts.get(selected) || 0) + 1);
  }
  const scoresFor = item => {
    const kind = String(item.kind || "");
    const tractable = /measurement|replication|test|audit|tournament/.test(kind) ? 22 : /bridge|consciousness/.test(kind) ? 8 : 14;
    const information = /tournament|discrimin|audit|replication/.test(`${kind} ${item.title}`.toLowerCase()) ? 24 : 14;
    const central = /spin|geometr|causal|conformal|invariant/.test(`${kind} ${item.title}`.toLowerCase()) ? 23 : 12;
    const ageDays = Math.max(0, Math.floor((now - new Date(item.importedAt || latestTimestamp).getTime()) / 86400000));
    const bypass = selectedCounts.size && (selectedCounts.get(item.id) || 0) === 0 ? (state.shadowDecisions || []).length : 0;
    const cheapFalsification = Math.min(30, Math.round((tractable * 0.58) + (information * 0.42)));
    const globalPromise = Math.round(item.priorityScore * .4 + information * .25 + cheapFalsification * .2 + central * .15);
    return { committed: item.priorityScore, "global-promise": globalPromise, "cheap-falsification": cheapFalsification, "information-gain": information, "mainline-centrality": central, "starvation-rescue": Math.min(30, Math.round(item.priorityScore * .55 + Math.min(8, ageDays / 7) + Math.min(7, bypass))) };
  };
  const targetRunners = 4;
  const projectedTasks = ranked.map((item, index) => {
    const schedulingTier = classifyResearchWorkItem(item, state);
    const activity = state.researchActivities?.[item.id] || null;
    const terminalActivity = activity?.status === "complete";
    const packetMissing = item.controlStatus === "eligible" && !terminalActivity && !runnablePacketByWorkItem.has(item.id);
    const ready = item.controlStatus === "eligible" && !terminalActivity && !packetMissing;
    const reviewing = item.controlStatus === "reviewing" && !terminalActivity;
    const report = latestReportByWorkItem.get(item.id) || null;
    const verifiedContinuationPending = reviewing && report?.reviewStatus === "completed";
    const researchField = classifyResearchField(item);
    const unblockTask = effectiveUnblockTasks.find(task => task.workItemId === item.id) || null;
    const actionable = ready || (reviewing && report);
    const high = item.priorityScore >= highCut;
    const itemLeases = Object.values(state.leases || {}).filter(lease => lease.workItemId === item.id);
    const interruptedAttempts = itemLeases.filter(lease => ["revoked", "expired"].includes(lease.status)).length;
    const interruptedDecomposition = item.kind === "non-atomic-result-decomposition" && item.controlStatus === "blocked" && interruptedAttempts > 0 && !itemLeases.some(lease => ["issued", "active"].includes(lease.status));
    const sequencedDecompositionSlice = item.controlStatus === "blocked"
      && item.sourceStatus === "atomic-child-of-reviewed-decomposition"
      && item.atomicClaim?.disposition === "unresolved"
      && item.dependencyIds?.length > 0
      && item.dependencyIds.every(id => String(id).startsWith("UNRESOLVED:"));
    const blockerType = ready || (reviewing && report) ? null
      : packetMissing ? "task-packet-missing"
      : reviewing ? "report-missing"
      : interruptedDecomposition ? "interrupted-execution"
      : sequencedDecompositionSlice ? "sequenced-research-slice"
      : item.dependencyIds?.length ? "dependency-missing"
      : unblockTask ? "remediation-required"
      : "human-or-policy-gate";
    const ageDays = Math.max(0, Math.floor((now - new Date(item.importedAt || latestTimestamp).getTime()) / 86400000));
    const starvation = ready && (ageDays >= 21 || (selectedCounts.size > 0 && (selectedCounts.get(item.id) || 0) === 0 && (state.shadowDecisions || []).length >= 3));
    return {
      id: item.id,
      rank: index + 1,
      title: item.title,
      priority: item.priorityScore,
      status: item.controlStatus,
      streamId: item.streamId,
      kind: item.kind,
      nextAction: item.nextAction,
      sourceRoute: item.sourceRoute || `/research-inbox#${item.id}`,
      geometry: actionable ? "ready-later" : (high ? "unblock" : "hold"),
      whyNext: ready && state.taskAssignments?.[item.id]?.scope === "bounded-next-action-slice" ? `Bounded next-action slice ready · parent programme remains ${item.sourceStatus} · priority ${item.priorityScore}` : ready ? `Execution-ready · priority ${item.priorityScore}` : packetMissing ? `Eligible item is missing its bounded task packet · generate and verify the execution contract before scheduling · priority ${item.priorityScore}` : verifiedContinuationPending ? `Independent verification complete · next bounded continuation is being generated · priority ${item.priorityScore}` : reviewing && report ? `Report emitted · independent review is the next actionable step · priority ${item.priorityScore}` : reviewing ? `Review cannot proceed until its emitted report is recovered · priority ${item.priorityScore}` : interruptedDecomposition ? `A prior local execution was interrupted after ${interruptedAttempts} attempt${interruptedAttempts === 1 ? "" : "s"}; retry the still-valid frozen decomposition packet while preserving its failure provenance.` : sequencedDecompositionSlice ? `This is a bounded unresolved-input slice from a reviewed decomposition, not a missing external dependency. Keep its parent blocked and release one sibling at a time after the preceding slice is terminal.` : `Blocked programme · priority ${item.priorityScore}; create or route an independent next-action slice`,
      actionKind: ready ? "execute" : reviewing && report ? "review" : "remedy",
      blockerType,
      programmeStatus: item.sourceStatus,
      executionScope: state.taskAssignments?.[item.id]?.scope || "programme",
      priorityHistoryCount: item.priorityHistory?.length || 0,
      ageDays,
      starvation,
      lensScores: { ...scoresFor(item), "field-fair": Math.max(1, ranked.length - index) },
      assignment: state.taskAssignments?.[item.id] || null,
      unblockTask,
      schedulingTier,
      report,
      researchField,
      activity: item.parentWorkItemId ? activity : null,
      activityFlow: item.parentWorkItemId ? null : (() => {
        const activities = Object.values(state.researchActivities || {}).filter(activity => activity.parentWorkItemId === item.id);
        const effectiveStatus = activity => {
          if (activity.status === "complete") return "complete";
          const controlStatus = state.workItems?.[activity.id]?.controlStatus;
          return ["eligible", "leased", "running", "reviewing"].includes(controlStatus) ? controlStatus : activity.status;
        };
        return {
          count: activities.length,
          complete: activities.filter(activity => effectiveStatus(activity) === "complete").length,
          eligible: activities.filter(activity => effectiveStatus(activity) === "eligible").length,
          blocked: activities.filter(activity => effectiveStatus(activity) === "blocked").length,
        };
      })(),
    };
  });
  // "Do next" is the scheduler's real first wave, not a percentile computed
  // across historical work. Fill the four-runner target in policy order while
  // respecting each tier's concurrency cap (currently two new claims).
  const firstWaveIds = new Set();
  const firstWaveTierCounts = new Map();
  for (const task of projectedTasks.filter(candidate => ["execute", "review"].includes(candidate.actionKind))) {
    if (firstWaveIds.size >= targetRunners) break;
    const cap = task.schedulingTier.maximumConcurrent;
    const selectedInTier = firstWaveTierCounts.get(task.schedulingTier.id) || 0;
    if (Number.isInteger(cap) && selectedInTier >= cap) continue;
    firstWaveIds.add(task.id);
    firstWaveTierCounts.set(task.schedulingTier.id, selectedInTier + 1);
  }
  const nextTasks = projectedTasks.map(task => ({
    ...task,
    geometry: ["execute", "review"].includes(task.actionKind)
      ? (firstWaveIds.has(task.id) ? "now" : "ready-later")
      : task.geometry,
  }));
  // Only non-terminal workers on the active session are live capacity. The
  // session retains historical workers for provenance, so counting every
  // worker record inflates both the capacity limit and the UI after restarts.
  const observedSession = activeSession || null;
  const observedWorkers = Object.values(observedSession?.workers || {}).filter(worker => !["complete", "stopped", "failed"].includes(worker.status));
  const executingWorkers = observedWorkers.filter(worker => worker.status === "working" && worker.currentTask);
  const reviewingWorkers = observedWorkers.filter(worker => worker.status === "waiting-review" && worker.currentTask);
  const readyWorkers = observedWorkers.filter(worker => worker.status === "standing-by");
  const explicitAttentionWorkers = observedWorkers.filter(worker => worker.status === "needs-attention");
  const inconsistentWorkers = observedWorkers.filter(worker => ["working", "waiting-review"].includes(worker.status) && !worker.currentTask);
  const attentionWorkers = [...explicitAttentionWorkers, ...inconsistentWorkers.filter(worker => !explicitAttentionWorkers.some(candidate => candidate.id === worker.id))];
  const workerCapacity = observedWorkers.length;
  const wip = nextTasks.filter(task => ["leased", "running"].includes(task.status)).length;
  const reviewQueue = nextTasks.filter(task => task.status === "reviewing" && task.report).length;
  const queuedCandidates = nextTasks.filter(task => ["now", "ready-later"].includes(task.geometry)).length;
  const executionAuthorized = state.autonomy?.mode === "BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS"
    && activeSession?.status === "active"
    && activeSession.mode === "BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS"
    && activeGrant?.status === "active";
  const executableNow = executionAuthorized
    ? nextTasks.filter(task => task.geometry === "now" && task.status === "eligible" && isWorkItemWithinBoundedGrant(state, activeGrant, state.workItems[task.id])).length
    : 0;
  const capacityState = [`${executingWorkers.length}/${workerCapacity} executing`];
  if (reviewingWorkers.length) capacityState.push(`${reviewingWorkers.length} awaiting review`);
  capacityState.push(`${executableNow} next`);
  const capacity = {
    workers: workerCapacity,
    wip,
    reviewQueue,
    wipLimit: workerCapacity,
    queuedCandidates,
    executableNow,
    pressure: workerCapacity === 0
      ? (queuedCandidates && !executionAuthorized ? "awaiting-authorization" : executableNow ? "runner-deficit" : "clear")
      : wip > workerCapacity ? "over-limit" : executableNow > Math.max(0, workerCapacity - wip) ? "queue-pressure" : "clear",
    message: workerCapacity === 0
      ? (queuedCandidates && !executionAuthorized ? `${queuedCandidates} queued candidates · awaiting authorization` : `${executableNow} authorized tasks, no active workers`)
      : capacityState.join(" · "),
  };
  const actionableTasks = nextTasks.filter(task => ["now", "ready-later"].includes(task.geometry));
  const openLeases = Object.values(state.leases || {}).filter(lease => ["issued", "active"].includes(lease.status));
  const activeNewClaimRunners = openLeases.filter(lease => {
    const item = state.workItems?.[lease.workItemId];
    return item && classifyResearchWorkItem(item, state).id === "new-claims";
  }).length;
  const workforceIssues = [];
  if (activeSession && observedWorkers.length < targetRunners) workforceIssues.push({ id: "runner-deficit", severity: "error", label: `${targetRunners - observedWorkers.length} runner${targetRunners - observedWorkers.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} missing`, detail: `${observedWorkers.length}/${targetRunners} runners are attached.` });
  if (activeSession && observedWorkers.length > targetRunners) workforceIssues.push({ id: "runner-surplus", severity: "attention", label: `${observedWorkers.length - targetRunners} runner${observedWorkers.length - targetRunners === 1 ? "" : "s"} above target`, detail: `${observedWorkers.length}/${targetRunners} runners are attached.` });
  const idleAuthorizedWorkers = activeSession?.mode === "BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS" ? readyWorkers : [];
  if (idleAuthorizedWorkers.length) workforceIssues.push({ id: "runner-idle", severity: "error", label: `${idleAuthorizedWorkers.length} active runner${idleAuthorizedWorkers.length === 1 ? " is" : "s are"} idle`, detail: `${idleAuthorizedWorkers.map(worker => worker.id.split("-").at(-1)).join(", ")} ${idleAuthorizedWorkers.length === 1 ? "has" : "have"} no real current task.` });
  if (activeSession && attentionWorkers.length) workforceIssues.push({ id: "runner-attention", severity: "error", label: `${attentionWorkers.length} runner${attentionWorkers.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} need attention`, detail: attentionWorkers.map(worker => worker.id.split("-").at(-1)).join(", ") });
  if (activeSession && inconsistentWorkers.length) workforceIssues.push({ id: "runner-state-incomplete", severity: "error", label: `${inconsistentWorkers.length} active runner state${inconsistentWorkers.length === 1 ? " is" : "s are"} incomplete`, detail: inconsistentWorkers.map(worker => worker.id.split("-").at(-1)).join(", ") });
  const continuationBacklog = nextTasks.filter(task => {
    if (task.status !== "reviewing" || task.report?.reviewStatus !== "completed") return false;
    // A reviewed report stops being a promotion backlog as soon as its
    // bounded successor is durable.  The parent intentionally remains open
    // while decomposition/activity children run, so status alone otherwise
    // reports a false incident throughout valid downstream processing.
    if ((task.activityFlow?.count || 0) > 0) return false;
    const reportId = task.report.id;
    return !Object.values(state.workItems || {}).some(candidate => {
      if (candidate.id === task.id) return false;
      const packet = packetByWorkItem.get(candidate.id);
      return candidate.sourceRunId === reportId
        || packet?.source?.sourceRunId === reportId
        || packet?.compiler?.sourceRunId === reportId;
    });
  });
  if (activeSession?.mode === "BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS" && !actionableTasks.length && !executingWorkers.length && !reviewingWorkers.length && !continuationBacklog.length) workforceIssues.push({ id: "task-inflow-empty", severity: "error", label: "No next actions appearing", detail: "The active mission has neither an execution-ready task nor an emitted report ready for review." });
  if (continuationBacklog.length) workforceIssues.push({ id: "continuation-promotion-backlog", severity: "error", label: `${continuationBacklog.length} verified report${continuationBacklog.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} await continuation`, detail: "Verified reports should automatically become bounded continuation tasks; no scientific verdict is required." });
  const insufficientActivityPlans = nextTasks.filter(task => !task.activity && task.status !== "closed" && task.activityFlow.count > 0 && task.activityFlow.count < 2);
  if (insufficientActivityPlans.length) workforceIssues.push({ id: "activity-fanout-insufficient", severity: "error", label: `${insufficientActivityPlans.length} task${insufficientActivityPlans.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} have insufficient activity fanout`, detail: "A parent research task normally requires at least two independently reviewable activities." });
  const stalledActivityPlans = nextTasks.filter(task => !task.activity && task.activityFlow?.count >= 2 && task.activityFlow.complete < task.activityFlow.count && task.activityFlow.eligible === 0 && !nextTasks.some(candidate => candidate.activity?.parentWorkItemId === task.id && ["leased", "running", "reviewing"].includes(candidate.status)));
  if (stalledActivityPlans.length) workforceIssues.push({ id: "activity-flow-stalled", severity: "error", label: `${stalledActivityPlans.length} activity plan${stalledActivityPlans.length === 1 ? " is" : "s are"} stalled`, detail: "Incomplete parent tasks have no eligible, running, or reviewable activity." });
  const savedLenses = Object.values(state.priorityLenses || {});
  const openProposals = Object.values(state.priorityProposals || {}).filter(proposal => proposal.status === "open");
  const lastRevertibleBatch = [...(state.priorityBatches || [])].reverse().find(batch => !batch.revertedBy && batch.changes.every(change => state.workItems[change.workItemId]?.priorityScore === change.to)) || null;
  const remedyRequired = effectiveUnblockTasks.length > 0 || continuationBacklog.length > 0 || insufficientActivityPlans.length > 0 || stalledActivityPlans.length > 0;
  const operatingStatus = activeSession?.status || (remedyRequired ? "needs-remedy" : queuedCandidates > 0 || reviewQueue > 0 ? "awaiting-authorization" : "idle");
  const activeFields = RESEARCH_FIELDS.map(field => {
    const tasks = nextTasks.filter(task => task.researchField.id === field.id && ["now", "ready-later"].includes(task.geometry));
    return { id: field.id, label: field.label, color: field.color, count: tasks.length, leader: tasks[0]?.id || null, inferenceCount: tasks.filter(task => task.researchField.provenance !== "declared").length };
  }).filter(field => field.count);
  const globalPromise = [...nextTasks].filter(task => ["now", "ready-later"].includes(task.geometry)).sort((a, b) => b.lensScores["global-promise"] - a.lensScores["global-promise"] || a.id.localeCompare(b.id)).map((task, index) => ({ rank: index + 1, id: task.id, title: task.title, score: task.lensScores["global-promise"], fieldId: task.researchField.id }));
  return freeze({
    protocol: RESEARCH_MISSION_CONTROL_PROTOCOL,
    activeSession,
    latestSession: sessions[0] || null,
    sessions,
    notifications,
    interventions,
    results,
    reports,
    nextTasks,
    capacity,
    operatingStatus,
    schedulingPolicy: { targetRunners, maximumConcurrentNewClaims: 2, activeNewClaimRunners, tiers: RESEARCH_SCHEDULING_TIERS, authorityBoundary: "The tier ladder chooses the next eligible task. It does not bypass review, evidence or autonomy gates." },
    fieldRotation: { mode: "tier-first-field-round-robin", lastFieldId: rotation.lastFieldId, nextFieldId: rotation.nextFieldId, fields: activeFields, inferenceBoundary: "Field membership uses declared metadata when present and a visible keyword fallback otherwise. Each field keeps its own internal tier and priority ranking." },
    globalPromise: { methodology: "40% committed priority + 25% information gain + 20% tractability + 15% programme centrality", calibratedProbability: false, items: globalPromise },
    workforceHealth: { healthy: workforceIssues.length === 0, targetRunners, attachedRunners: observedWorkers.length, executingRunners: executingWorkers.length, workingRunners: executingWorkers.length, reviewingRunners: reviewingWorkers.length, readyRunners: readyWorkers.length, attentionRunners: attentionWorkers.length, attentionRunnerIds: attentionWorkers.map(worker => worker.id), unassignedRunnerIds: [...idleAuthorizedWorkers, ...inconsistentWorkers.filter(worker => !idleAuthorizedWorkers.some(candidate => candidate.id === worker.id))].map(worker => worker.id), actionableTasks: actionableTasks.length, issues: workforceIssues },
    unblockTasks: effectiveUnblockTasks,
    priorityLenses: [...BUILTIN_PRIORITY_LENSES, ...savedLenses.map(lens => ({ id: lens.id, name: lens.name, description: lens.description, sourceLensId: lens.sourceLensId }))],
    priorityProposals: openProposals,
    lastRevertibleBatch,
    starvationSignals: nextTasks.filter(task => task.starvation),
    streams: Object.entries(state.streams || {}).map(([id, stream]) => ({ id, title: stream.title })),
    priorityGeometry: {
      xAxis: "readiness: blocked → executable",
      yAxis: "scheduler wave: later → next",
      highCut,
      cells: [
        { id: "now", label: "Do next", meaning: "The next four scheduler selections, in policy-tier and field-fair order, including independent artifact review and subject to tier concurrency caps." },
        { id: "unblock", label: "Remedy", meaning: "High-priority work with a typed process, dependency, report, or intervention blocker. The control plane must create and verify remediation before retrying." },
        { id: "ready-later", label: "Cultivate", meaning: "Valid automation beyond the current four-runner scheduling wave; it advances when a Do next slot opens." },
        { id: "hold", label: "Hold", meaning: "Work that is not autonomously actionable. Each item must expose a typed human, authority, dependency, quarantine, or exhaustion gate." },
      ],
      authorityBoundary: "Priority changes attention order; they never grant a lease, resolve a dependency, or assert scientific truth.",
    },
    counts: {
      sessions: sessions.length,
      activeWorkers: activeSession ? Object.values(activeSession.workers).filter(worker => !["complete", "stopped", "failed"].includes(worker.status)).length : 0,
      unreadNotifications: notifications.filter(item => item.status === "unread").length,
      loudNotifications: notifications.filter(item => item.status === "unread" && item.soundPolicy === "loud").length,
      openInterventions: interventions.filter(item => item.status === "open").length,
      results: results.length,
      reports: reports.length,
      nextTasks: nextTasks.length,
      unblockTasks: effectiveUnblockTasks.length,
      openPriorityProposals: openProposals.length,
      starvationSignals: nextTasks.filter(task => task.starvation).length,
    },
    safety: {
      autonomyMode: state.autonomy.mode,
      externalEffectsAuthorized: false,
      activeGrantIds: Object.entries(state.autonomy.grants).filter(([, grant]) => grant.status === "active").map(([id]) => id),
      activeGrant: activeGrant ? { id: activeSession.grantId, expiresAt: activeGrant.expiresAt, selfRenewal: activeGrant.selfRenewal === true, renewalCount: Number(activeGrant.renewalCount || 0), maximumWallClockMinutes: activeGrant.maximumWallClockMinutes } : null,
    },
  });
}
